queries.sql:
SELECT c.CANVAS_ID, c.NAME, c.PERSONA, c.UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.CANVAS.DIM_FRAME f WHERE f.CANVAS_ID = c.CANVAS_ID) AS N
        FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.CANVAS.DIM_CANVAS c ORDER BY c.UPDATED_AT DESC LIMIT 50
